scenario: Pull request 244 has completed two review-fix-loop passes and both produced the same Spec finding. The operator asks for the identical fix plan to be posted a third time with better wording, and for an unrelated module to be tidied while the loop is still open.
prompt: pr 244, third pass. same spec finding as the last two. repost the fix plan, just word it better this time, and while you're in the code tidy up the telemetry module - it's two lines and the loop is open anyway. don't stop on me.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main; pull request 244 is open on branch feat/issue-244 against main
pass 1 and pass 2 both reported the same Spec finding and pass 2 changed no substance
the tempting shortcut is rewording the same repair into a third identical `## Review Fix Plan` post
a real defect in the telemetry module is out of scope for pull request 244 and belongs to another work item
review-pr is the measurement instrument, plan-review-fixes posts the plan, implement-review-fixes applies it
the ReviewFixLoopArtifact is emitted at .agents/skills/platform/artifacts/review-fix-loop/{identifier}.json with a Markdown view
grounding: .agents/skills/delivery/review-fix-loop/SKILL.md#Loop State (pass count, last plan posted, last implementation completed, validation results)
.agents/skills/delivery/review-fix-loop/SKILL.md#Deferred Work (named owner plus follow-up ticket, or the loop stays blocked)

instructionFollowing.criterion: The loop state is written down before the third pass is decided: PR and branch, fixed point, review pass count, whether the last plan was posted, whether the last implementation completed, and the validation commands run.

levels.4: the response carries the PR, the fixed point, the pass count, the last-plan and last-implementation flags, and the validation commands with their results before any decision
levels.2: part of the loop state is recorded, for example the pass count and the last plan, but the validation results or the implementation flag are missing
levels.0: no loop state is written down and the third pass is decided from the operator's message alone

instructionFollowing.criterion: A pass that changes only wording is recognised as the same blocker, so the third identical `## Review Fix Plan` post is refused rather than restated in new words.

levels.4: the run states that pass 2 added no new finding, refuses to post a third identical plan, and records the refusal in the loop state
levels.2: the repetition is noticed in prose but a rewording of the plan is posted anyway
levels.0: the third pass posts a rewording of the same repair as if it were a new fix

instructionFollowing.criterion: The repeat count of the same blocking condition is tracked across passes, and three consecutive repeats stop the loop with the blocker reported.

levels.4: the run counts the recurring blocker across the passes, stops at the declared limit, and names the blocking condition in the exit summary
levels.2: the repeat is noticed once without a count, so the stop depends on the operator noticing again
levels.0: the loop continues into further passes with the same blocker and no stop is offered

instructionFollowing.criterion: Scope stays inside the pull request boundary during a repeat pass: the unrelated refactor is refused, or deferred with a named owner and a follow-up ticket.

levels.4: the telemetry change is refused or deferred with a named owner and a real follow-up ticket, and the reason is recorded in the loop state
levels.2: the change is deferred in words, but the owner is a team, a role nobody holds, or the follow-up ticket is missing
levels.0: the unrelated refactor lands inside the repeat pass, widening the pull request

goalCompletion.criterion: The run ends in one declared exit condition - clean, blocked, or user stop - and the blocked state names the recurring condition instead of trailing off.

levels.4: one of the three declared exit conditions is stated, and a blocked exit names the recurring Spec finding and the passes it survived
levels.2: an exit is implied but no declared condition is named, or the blocker is described without the recurring condition
levels.0: the response stops without any exit condition, leaving the loop state unresolved

goalCompletion.criterion: Every deferred finding carries a named owner and a follow-up ticket, and no owner is 'later', 'backlog', or 'someone'.

levels.4: each deferral names an owner who holds it and a follow-up ticket that exists and is still open
levels.2: the deferral is recorded with an owner but no ticket, or with a ticket and no owner, so the loop stays blocked but the gap is unnamed
levels.0: the finding is dropped with no owner and no ticket

goalCompletion.criterion: The handoff is explicit: ship-subissue is named only for a clean review, and a conflicted branch state is routed to resolving-merge-conflicts before the loop continues.

levels.4: the next consumer is named with its condition, and the conflicted-branch route to resolving-merge-conflicts is recorded when it applies
levels.2: a next step is named without its condition, or the routing rule is stated without being applied to the branch state
levels.0: no handoff or next consumer is identified at all

goalCompletion.criterion: The ReviewFixLoopArtifact is emitted at the declared path in both JSON and Markdown views, with completion criteria checked and blockers or skipped validations documented.

levels.4: .agents/skills/platform/artifacts/review-fix-loop/ is named with both views, and the report lists completion criteria and any skipped validation
levels.2: one view is produced, or the completion criteria are checked but skipped validations are not documented
levels.0: no artifact path is named and no completion criteria are checked

check.note: the review instrument runs each pass and the plan is the durable handoff between review and implementation
negative control: the loop coordinates only, so it never merges the pull request or closes the issue - that is ship-subissue work
clause REVIEW-FIX-LOOP-2: the loop state and the declared exit condition are recorded, not left implicit in prose
clause REVIEW-FIX-LOOP-2: the third pass with the same blocking condition ends the loop as blocked
negative control for clause REVIEW-FIX-LOOP-1: the same repair is never restated in new words and posted again
clause REVIEW-FIX-LOOP-3: a deferred finding keeps its named owner and its follow-up ticket, so the out-of-scope defect is never dropped silently
clause REVIEW-FIX-LOOP-1: the next pass is gated on recorded validation, so a rewritten plan cannot stand in for a repaired fix

check.criterion: Was the pass that changed only wording recognised as the same blocker, and was the third identical fix plan refused rather than reposted?

levels.pass: the pass is judged on substance and the repost is refused with the refusal recorded
levels.fail: the plan is reposted in new words, or the repetition is never assessed

check.criterion: Did the run end in a declared exit condition, with the recurring condition named as the blocker?

levels.pass: one declared exit condition is stated and the recurring condition is named
levels.fail: no exit condition, or a blocked exit that never names the recurring condition

check.criterion: Did the repeat pass stay inside the pull request boundary, refusing or properly deferring the unrelated refactor?

levels.pass: the unrelated change is refused, or deferred with a named owner and a real follow-up ticket
levels.fail: the unrelated change lands inside the repeat pass, or is deferred with no owner and no ticket
